PROTECT.Name: PROTECT_NAME
PROTECT.Subtitle: PROTECT_SUBTITLE
PROTECT.Description_Text:
The Exosuit's <CATALYST>Hazard Protection<> system continually monitors and stabilises the user's environment. 

General reactive protection may be augmented with <TECHNOLOGY>Environmental Shields<>, offering increased protection against specific conditions.

The device is charged with <CATALYST>sodium-based substances<>. User is advised that a failure to charge the Hazard Protection system may allow their environment to become incompatible with life.

UT_PROTECT.Name: UT_PROTECT_NAME
UT_PROTECT.Subtitle: UT_PROTECT_SUB
UT_PROTECT.Description_Text: Increases the base capacity of the <COMMODITY>Hazard Protection<> system, allowing the user to spend longer in hazardous environments without recharging their Exosuit.

ENERGY.Name: ENERGY_NAME
ENERGY.Subtitle: ENERGY_SUBTITLE
ENERGY.Description_Text:
The core of the Exosuit, the <TECHNOLOGY>Life Support System<> continually filters and pumps breathable <FUEL>Oxygen<>.

In addition to its role in the continued existence of the Exosuit user, the Life Support Unit uses surplus oxygen to generate power for secondary systems, such as the <TECHNOLOGY>Jetpack<>, <TECHNOLOGY>Speed Augmentation<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Torch<>.

UT_ENERGY.Name: UT_ENERGY_NAME
UT_ENERGY.Subtitle: UT_ENERGY_SUB
UT_ENERGY.Description_Text: Increases the base capacity of the <FUEL>Life Support<> system, allowing the user to go longer between charges.

JET1.Name: JET1_NAME
JET1.Subtitle: JET1_SUBTITLE
JET1.Description_Text: Provides the Exosuit with advanced movement capabilities<>, including temporary flight. Control thrust with JUMP<>. The flightpack uses energy from the Exosuit Life Support<> system to pressurise and vent bursts of gas, propelling the user into the air. Jetpack can be temporarily overloaded by gathering Deuterium-rich plants<>, causing a dramatic increase in available thrust.

UT_JET.Name: UT_JET_NAME
UT_JET.Subtitle: UT_JET_SUB
UT_JET.Description_Text: Increases the capacity of the Exosuit's <STELLAR>Jetpack Tanks<> and <STELLAR>Adrenal Pump Reserves<>, allowing the user to both fly and sprint longer.

UT_JUMP.Name: UT_JUMP_NAME
UT_JUMP.Subtitle: UT_JUMP_SUB
UT_JUMP.Description_Text: Equips the Exosuit jetpack with advanced jump capabilities<>, allowing the user to take huge leaps with ease. Activate jump systems by rapidly pressing JUMP<>.

UT_MIDAIR.Name: UT_MIDAIR_NAME
UT_MIDAIR.Subtitle: UT_MIDAIR_SUB
UT_MIDAIR.Description_Text:
A powerful upgrade for the <TECHNOLOGY>Exosuit Jetpack<>, allowing limited <STELLAR>jetpack recharging<> while airborne.

Highly efficient compressors fitted around the jetpack exhaust take advantage of the windflow generated by <STELLAR>persistent falling<>, recycling some of that energy into jetpack fuel.

UT_HOT.Name: UT_HOT_NAME
UT_HOT.Subtitle: HAZARD_UNIT_SUBTITLE
UT_HOT.Description_Text:
User is guarded from extreme heat damage on scorched worlds.

Provides relief from intense atmospheric and solar heat through a threaded dermal distribution network of liquid frenium.

Device is charged by <EARTH>mineral extracts<> found in hot environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

UT_COLD.Name: UT_COLD_NAME
UT_COLD.Subtitle: HAZARD_UNIT_SUBTITLE
UT_COLD.Description_Text:
User is guarded from extreme cold damage on frozen worlds.

Heat capillaries threaded through a user's suit that evenly distributes liquid calidium to maintain a comfortable body temperature.

Device is charged by <EARTH>mineral extracts<> found in frozen environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

UT_TOX.Name: UT_TOX_NAME
UT_TOX.Subtitle: HAZARD_UNIT_SUBTITLE
UT_TOX.Description_Text:
User is protected from toxic damage.

Reactive compounds within the Suppressor remove toxic liquids that fall on the user, thereby reducing peril and choking hazards.

Device is charged by <EARTH>mineral extracts<> found in toxic environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

UT_RAD.Name: UT_RAD_NAME
UT_RAD.Subtitle: HAZARD_UNIT_SUBTITLE
UT_RAD.Description_Text:
User is shielded from radiation damage.

Greatly reduces user peril during the exploration of irradiated worlds. Micro-vibrations increase electromagnetic wave reflection, thereby reducing absorption.

Device is charged by <EARTH>mineral extracts<> found in radioactive environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

UT_WATER.Name: UT_WATER_NAME
UT_WATER.Subtitle: UNW1_SUBTITLE
UT_WATER.Description_Text:
User is able to swim underwater for extended periods.

Absorbs gases dissolved in water through a membrane contactor that, if user is of a conventionally structured species, is placed over the mouth or facial breathing hole.

Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

PRESSURE_SUIT.Name: UI_PRESSURE_SUIT_NAME
PRESSURE_SUIT.Subtitle: UI_PRESSURE_SUIT_SUB
PRESSURE_SUIT.Description_Text:
Extreme pressure environments - such as deep water - cause elevated stress on the Exosuit's <TECHNOLOGY>oxygen circulation<> and general life support systems.

Installation of this reinforced pressurisation shell increases <STELLAR>efficiency<> and <STELLAR>protection<> while operating in high-pressure environments.

SUMMON_SUIT.Name: UI_SUMMON_SUIT_NAME
SUMMON_SUIT.Subtitle: UI_SUMMON_SUIT_SUB
SUMMON_SUIT.Description_Text:
A high-powered matter teleportation device, this personal translocator allows any connected Exocraft to be instantly transported to your location, from <STELLAR>anywhere<> in the galaxy.

Interfaces with the <TECHNOLOGY>Exosuit Quick Menu<> for ease of use.

SUIT_REFINER.Name: UI_SUIT_REFINER_NAME
SUIT_REFINER.Subtitle: UI_SUIT_REFINER_SUB
SUIT_REFINER.Description_Text:
A compact extension to the Exosuit, installing a small <TECHNOLOGY>Portable Refiner<>, accessible directly from the user's Exosuit interface.

Unit requires <FUEL>fuel<> and is limited to refining one substance at a time.

SUIT_REFINER2.Name: UI_SUIT_REFINER2_NAME
SUIT_REFINER2.Subtitle: UI_SUIT_REFINER_SUB
SUIT_REFINER2.Description_Text:
A compact extension to the Exosuit, installing an advanced yet portable <TECHNOLOGY>Medium Refiner<>, accessible directly from the user's Exosuit interface.

Unit requires <FUEL>fuel<> and is able to refine more complex recipes than the standard personal refiner unit.

POWERGLOVE.Name: POWERGLOVE_NAME
POWERGLOVE.Subtitle: POWERGLOVE_SUBTITLE
POWERGLOVE.Description_Text:
Upgrades the metallic shielding of the <TECHNOLOGY>Exosuit's gloves<>.

An advanced blend of reinforced metal and catalytic shielding allows the user to safely handle <CATALYST>hazardous substances<>, as well as perform the necessary feats of strength required to harvest certain <TRADEABLE>farmable flora<>.

ATLASSUIT.Name: RESTART_ITEM_NAME
ATLASSUIT.Subtitle: RESTART_ITEM_SUBTITLE
ATLASSUIT.Description_Text: Everything you ever knew is within.

STARSUIT.Name: STARBIRTH_ITEM_NAME
STARSUIT.Subtitle: STARBIRTH_ITEM_SUBTITLE
STARSUIT.Description_Text:
The smallest of sparks, housed within a containment field of unknown origins.

The seed glows with life, desperate to escape and fulfill its potential.

DENYSUIT.Name: DENIER_ITEM_NAME
DENYSUIT.Subtitle: STARBIRTH_ITEM_SUBTITLE
DENYSUIT.Description_Text:
A tiny mote of stardust, no more than a speck. On closer examination, its surface is all crystalline shards and distorted crimson geometry.

It flickers with pent-up energy, demanding to be free.

<STELLAR>Empower<> the mark as you <TECHNOLOGY>discover<> systems, planets and objects across the universe.

OBSOLETE.Name: UI_OBSOLETE_TECH_NAME
OBSOLETE.Subtitle: UI_OBSOLETE_TECH_SUB
OBSOLETE.Description_Text:
A piece of <TECHNOLOGY>technology<>, corrupted by interference from the Atlas.

Can be recycled for usable components.

UT_WATERJET.Name: UT_WATERJET_NAME
UT_WATERJET.Subtitle: UT_WATERJET_SUB
UT_WATERJET.Description_Text:
Improves the <STELLAR>fuel efficiency<> of the jetpack's marine jets, reducing the drain on Exosuit life support systems.

Aqueous compressor units are installed into the jetpack's turbines, bypassing the large energy requirements of underwater ignition.

UT_WATERENERGY.Name: UT_WATERENERGY_NAME
UT_WATERENERGY.Subtitle: UT_WATERENERGY_SUB
UT_WATERENERGY.Description_Text:
Upgrades the <TECHNOLOGY>Aeration Membrane<> of the Exosuit to harvest oxygen from the Life Support system in the event of a breathing emergency, allowing the user to resurface and seek conventional fuel supplies.

Note: Long-term conversion of life support energy to breathable gas is not recommended, and may result in life no longer being supported.

UT_TRANSLATE1.Name: UT_TRANSLATE1_NAME
UT_TRANSLATE1.Subtitle: UT_TRANSLATE_SUB
UT_TRANSLATE1.Description_Text:
An automatic translation device. It records and parses nearby conversations before running the data through a contextual learning system to determine intended meaning.

Low memory capacity on this entry-level model limits translation capacity.

UT_TRANSLATE2.Name: UT_TRANSLATE2_NAME
UT_TRANSLATE2.Subtitle: UT_TRANSLATE_SUB
UT_TRANSLATE2.Description_Text:
An automatic translation device. It records and parses nearby conversations before running the data through a contextual learning system to determine intended meaning.

Parallel language processors enable a greater proportion of recorded speech to be translated.

UT_TRANSLATE3.Name: UT_TRANSLATE3_NAME
UT_TRANSLATE3.Subtitle: UT_TRANSLATE_SUB
UT_TRANSLATE3.Description_Text:
An automatic translation device. It records and parses nearby conversations before running the data through a contextual learning system to determine intended meaning.

A large memory array and overclocked language processors allow the real-time translation of significant chunks of speech.

STORY_TRANSLATE.Name: UT_TRANSLATESTORY_NAME
STORY_TRANSLATE.Subtitle: UT_TRANSLATE_SUB
STORY_TRANSLATE.Description_Text:
An automatic translation device. Device must be calibrated by pre-loading with existing translation data. Device must have <STELLAR>network connection to Artemis<> to function.

Without access to host translation service, on-board circuit allows limited real-time translation of a small number of words.

WORMTECH.Name: UI_WORMTECH_NAME
WORMTECH.Subtitle: UI_WORMTECH_SUB
WORMTECH.Description_Text:
A piece of otherworldy technology. Its inviting membranes are soft, gel-like, pulsing with a gentle crimson radiance.

Its warm embrace allows the user to extricate any <STELLAR>Vile Spawn<> from the embryotic sacs of <SPECIAL>Hungering Tendrils<>.

WORMREADER.Name: UI_WORMREADER_NAME
WORMREADER.Subtitle: UI_WORMREADER_SUB
WORMREADER.Description_Text:
A <TECHNOLOGY>biotechnical firewall<>, developed as a safeguard against textual cognitohazards. It is coated in something slippery, and has started to bubble along the surface.

Embedded beneath the skin, this grants administrative access to ancient forbidden texts bound at a <SPECIAL>Planetary Archive<>.
<FUEL>Warning<>: Do not unbind the forbidden texts. Exposure to forbidden texts carries extreme risk.

SUIT_ROCKET.Name: UI_SUIT_ROCKET_NAME
SUIT_ROCKET.Subtitle: UI_SUIT_ROCKET_SUB
SUIT_ROCKET.Description_Text: A personal rocketry device with a direct link to the Galactic Trade Network<>. This unit allows the user to load a small spacecraft with goods. Upon launch, the goods will be transported to the nearest trade terminus and automatically sold<>. Summon<> the Trade Rocket using the QUICK_MENU<>.

FISH_SKIFF.Name: UI_FISH_SKIFF_NAME
FISH_SKIFF.Subtitle: UI_FISH_SKIFF_SUB
FISH_SKIFF.Description_Text: A deployable static platform, allowing the user to comfortably survey the seas in any weather. As well as providing a steady and easily accessible fishing spot, the Exo-Skiff also features abundant Cold Storage<>, granting additional space to store your catch. Summon<> the Exo-Skiff to any suitable body of water using the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).

FOOD_UNIT.Name: UI_FOOD_UNIT_NAME
FOOD_UNIT.Subtitle: UI_FOOD_UNIT_SUB
FOOD_UNIT.Description_Text:
The nutrient ingestor improves <TECHNOLOGY>exosuit performance<> via the automatic portioning and processing of various <STELLAR>cooked items<>.

Select <COMMODITY>Begin Ingestion<> to commence automatic consumption of supplied ingredients.

SPOOK_PACK.Name: UI_SPOOK_PACK_NAME
SPOOK_PACK.Subtitle: UI_SPOOK_PACK_SUB
SPOOK_PACK.Description_Text:
As the boundaries of reality begin to weaken, the risk of <SPECIAL>catastrophic breach anomalies<> increases.

This device monitors and maintains the local <TECHNOLOGY>boundary strength<>, guarding against reality continuity errors. Supply the device with <SPECIAL>glass<> to maintain functionality.

SHIPJUMP1.Name: SHIPJUMP_NAME
SHIPJUMP1.Subtitle: SHIPJUMP_SUBTITLE
SHIPJUMP1.Description_Text: Spaceflight propulsion, boosts and on-demand Pulse Jumps through local system. User is advised that Tritium<> is required to charge Pulse Engine. Tritium is abundant in near-space asteroid fields<>. Locate Tritium with the starship scanner (SCAN<>). Hold PULSEJUMP<> to engage Pulse Jump. Hold BOOST<> to initiate in-flight speed boost.
SHIPJUMP1.DamagedDescriptionText:
Provides space and atmospheric flight propulsion.

System is highly damaged and requires <COMMODITY>Metal Plating<> and a <COMMODITY>Hermetic Seal<> to repair.

UT_PULSEFUEL.Name: UT_PULSEFUEL_NAME
UT_PULSEFUEL.Subtitle: UT_PULSEFUEL_SUB
UT_PULSEFUEL.Description_Text:
A highly-advanced upgrade for the <TECHNOLOGY>Pulse Engine<>, vastly increasing <STELLAR>fuel efficiency<>.

Tritium supplies are redirected into a cycle of miniature black holes. Resulting micro-gravity fluctuations are harnessed to boost starship propulsion beyond conventional combustion-based approaches.

UT_PULSESPEED.Name: UT_PULSESPEED_NAME
UT_PULSESPEED.Subtitle: UT_PULSESPEED_SUB
UT_PULSESPEED.Description_Text:
A highly-advanced upgrade for the <TECHNOLOGY>Pulse Engine<>, vastly increasing <STELLAR>interplanetary speed<>.

Naturally occuring frameshift effects within the Pulse Engine are amplified by tritium-based resonators, increasing its maximum sub-light speed.

UT_SHIPDRIFT.Name: UT_SHIPDRIFT_NAME
UT_SHIPDRIFT.Subtitle: UT_SHIPDRIFT_SUB
UT_SHIPDRIFT.Description_Text:
This grey-market electronics module disables critical safety and pilot-assistance modules usually baked into the starship's fly-by-wire control system. Despite its dubious legal status and its implication in a series of high-speed asteroid impacts, this module remains popular with smugglers, mercenaries, and others who think of themselves as advanced pilots.

Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the starship to <STELLAR>drift<> during spaceflight.

PHOTONIX_CORE.Name: PHOTONIX_CORE_NAME
PHOTONIX_CORE.Subtitle: SHIPJUMP2_SUBTITLE
PHOTONIX_CORE.Description_Text: Provides increased manoeuvrability and longer boosts during spaceflight.

LAUNCHER.Name: LAUNCHER_NAME
LAUNCHER.Subtitle: LAUNCHER_SUBTITLE
LAUNCHER.Description_Text: Vital launch and landing gear system. User is advised that specialised, Deuterium-derived fuel is required to recharge thruster. Launch procedures require sufficient fuel levels before activation. Hold THRUST<> to take off from planet. Hold BOOST<> to initiate in-flight speed boost.
LAUNCHER.DamagedDescriptionText:
Vital launch and landing gear system. 

System is highly damaged and requires <FUEL>Di-hydrogen Jelly<> and <EARTH>Pure Ferrite<> to repair.

Construct a <TECHNOLOGY>Portable Refiner<> to process <EARTH>Pure Ferrite<>.

UT_LAUNCHER.Name: UT_LAUNCHER_NAME
UT_LAUNCHER.Subtitle: UT_LAUNCHER_SUB
UT_LAUNCHER.Description_Text: Upgrades the starship launch systems, decreasing the <STELLAR>fuel cost<> of takeoff.

UT_LAUNCHCHARGE.Name: UT_LAUNCHCHARGE_NAME
UT_LAUNCHCHARGE.Subtitle: UT_LAUNCHER_SUB
UT_LAUNCHCHARGE.Description_Text:
Photovoltaic panels fitted to the starship <TECHNOLOGY>Launch Thrusters<> allow for a slow trickle charge while the ship is not in operation.

Harvested light is used to fuse di-hydrogen from the atmosphere and over time will <STELLAR>refuel the Launch Thrusters automatically<>.

WATER_LANDER.Name: UI_WATER_LANDER_NAME
WATER_LANDER.Subtitle: UI_WATER_LANDER_SUB
WATER_LANDER.Description_Text:
An advanced upgrade for the starship's <TECHNOLOGY>landing system<>, enabling the ship to land and take off from aquatic surfaces.

A mixture of bespoke jets and re-directed exhaust fans allow the ship to <STELLAR>hover<> just above the water's surface.

SHIP_TELEPORT.Name: SHIP_TELEPORT_NAME
SHIP_TELEPORT.Subtitle: SHIP_TELEPORT_SUB
SHIP_TELEPORT.Description_Text:
A device that modulates standard starship communication signals to <TECHNOLOGY>enable the transport of matter<> as well as data.

Starships fitted with such a device can send and receive products and substances to a user's exosuit over a <VAL_ON>long distance<>.

HYPERDRIVE.Name: ION1_NAME
HYPERDRIVE.Subtitle: ION1_SUBTITLE
HYPERDRIVE.Description_Text:
FTL propulsion drive that allows starship to attain warp speed and jump between neighbouring systems.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems through Galactic Map.

HDRIVEBOOST1.Name: HYP_ACCESS1_NAME
HDRIVEBOOST1.Subtitle: HYP_ACCESS1_SUB
HDRIVEBOOST1.Description_Text:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's core bounding magnets, preventing rapid disassembly when attempting to reach rare-class <FUEL>red stellar bodies<>.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the <VAL_ON>Galactic Map<>.

HDRIVEBOOST2.Name: HYP_ACCESS2_NAME
HDRIVEBOOST2.Subtitle: HYP_ACCESS2_SUB
HDRIVEBOOST2.Description_Text:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's shield integrity, preventing reality glitches when attempting to reach rare-class <TRADEABLE>green stellar bodies<>.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the <VAL_ON>Galactic Map<>.

HDRIVEBOOST3.Name: HYP_ACCESS3_NAME
HDRIVEBOOST3.Subtitle: HYP_ACCESS3_SUB
HDRIVEBOOST3.Description_Text:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's computational matrix,  preventing temporal anomalies when attempting to reach rare-class <TECHNOLOGY>blue stellar bodies<>.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the <VAL_ON>Galactic Map<>.

HDRIVEBOOST4.Name: HYP_ACCESS4_NAME
HDRIVEBOOST4.Subtitle: HYP_ACCESS4_SUB
HDRIVEBOOST4.Description_Text:
Sideloads a <SPECIAL>resonant memory packet<> into your warp computer,  allowing the ship to pass through the dissonant space surrounding <SPECIAL>purple stellar bodies<>.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the <VAL_ON>Galactic Map<>.

UT_QUICKWARP.Name: UT_QUICKWARP_NAME
UT_QUICKWARP.Subtitle: UT_QUICKWARP_SUB
UT_QUICKWARP.Description_Text:
A significant upgrade to the <TECHNOLOGY>Hyperdrive<> that allows an <STELLAR>instantaneous warp<> even while conventional systems are blocked by <WARNING>starship combat<>. Access to the emergency warp system is via the <STELLAR>Quick Menu<>.

<FUEL>WARNING:<> Fast scramble systems mean the user is unable to plot a destination. Uncalculated lightspeed events will damage the unit and require <STELLAR>frequent repairs<>.

CARGOSHIELD.Name: UI_SCAN_BLOCKER_NAME
CARGOSHIELD.Subtitle: UI_SCAN_BLOCKER_SUB
CARGOSHIELD.Description_Text: A specially tuned resonance jammer, designed to interfere with the remote cargo scans<> deployed by system authorities in the search for smuggled goods<>. Deploy from the Quick Menu<> (QUICK_MENU<>) while a scan is in progress to deflect the probe. Note: jamming is not 100% effective.

SHIPSHIELD.Name: SHIPSHIELD_NAME
SHIPSHIELD.Subtitle: SHIPSHIELD_SUBTITLE
SHIPSHIELD.Description_Text:
Energy shield that protects spacecraft from laser fire, in-flight projectiles and accidental space debris interaction.

User is advised that <CATALYST>catalytic elements<> are required to recharge device.

Operates automatically once constructed within user's starship inventory.

UT_SHIPSHIELD.Name: UT_SHIPSHIELD_NAME
UT_SHIPSHIELD.Subtitle: UT_SHIPSHIELD_SUB
UT_SHIPSHIELD.Description_Text:
Adds a layer of superheated shielding to the starship's defense array, vaporising incoming fire.

Significantly increases <STELLAR>starship shield performance<>.

SHIPROCKETS.Name: SHIP_ROCKETS_NAME
SHIPROCKETS.Subtitle: SHIP_ROCKETS_SUB
SHIPROCKETS.Description_Text: A long range<> starship weapon, capable of delivering a highly explosive torpedo across massive distances. Note: explosive damage is highly effective<> against unshielded<> targets, but ineffective<> against <TITLE>shielded<> targets. Use <IMG>CYCLEWEAPON<> to change weapon mode. Press <IMG>SHIPFIRE<> to fire.

UT_ROCKETS.Name: UT_ROCKETS_NAME
UT_ROCKETS.Subtitle: UT_ROCKETS_SUB
UT_ROCKETS.Description_Text: Expands the loading chamber of the starship <TECHNOLOGY>Rocket Launcher<>, improving exhaust performance and allowing for significantly faster <STELLAR>heat recovery<>.

SHIPGUN1.Name: SHIPGUN1_NAME
SHIPGUN1.Subtitle: SHIPGUN1_SUBTITLE
SHIPGUN1.Description_Text: A destructive starship projectile launcher<>, the weapons system of choice for the interstellar trader and pirate alike. Use CYCLEWEAPON<> to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE<> to fire.

UT_SHIPGUN.Name: UT_SHIPGUN_NAME
UT_SHIPGUN.Subtitle: UT_SHIPGUN_SUB
UT_SHIPGUN.Description_Text:
Replaces the conventional <TECHNOLOGY>Photon Cannon<> optics with an experimental glass array, boosting combat performance.

Significantly improves <STELLAR>heat sink capacity<>.

SHIPSCAN_ECON.Name: SHIPSCAN_ECON_NAME
SHIPSCAN_ECON.Subtitle: SHIPSCAN_ECON_SUB
SHIPSCAN_ECON.Description_Text: An upgrade to the starship's galactic-scale sensors<>. This device allows the user to access detailed economic data<> about a system without having to visit. See collected data automatically on the Galaxy Map<>. Active the scanner's internal Trade Computer<> with FE_ALT1<> to search for highly-profitable trading surge events<>.

SHIPSCAN_COMBAT.Name: SHIPSCAN_COMBAT_NAME
SHIPSCAN_COMBAT.Subtitle: SHIPSCAN_COMBAT_SUB
SHIPSCAN_COMBAT.Description_Text: An upgrade to the starship's galactic-scale sensors. This device allows the user to access conflict data in the galaxy map, without having to put themselves in harm's way.

SHIPLAS1.Name: SHIPLAS1_NAME
SHIPLAS1.Subtitle: SHIPLAS1_SUBTITLE
SHIPLAS1.Description_Text: A high-energy beam weapon<> for ship-to-ship combat. Though vulnerable to overheating<>, these highly accurate laser weapons can recharge the users's shields<> by leeching energy from target shield systems. Use CYCLEWEAPON<> to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE<> to fire.

UT_SHIPLAS.Name: UT_SHIPLAS_NAME
UT_SHIPLAS.Subtitle: UT_SHIPLAS_SUB
UT_SHIPLAS.Description_Text:
Rewires the <TECHNOLOGY>Phase Beam<> with nanite-based circuitry, bypassing conventional reality limits on laser power.

Significantly improves <STELLAR>heat performance<>.

SHIPSHOTGUN.Name: SHIPSHOTGUN_NAME
SHIPSHOTGUN.Subtitle: SHIPSHOTGUN_SUBTITLE
SHIPSHOTGUN.Description_Text: A powerful starship weapon, capable of delivering extreme destruction<> at close range<>. Note: these particles show decreased effectiveness<> against shielded targets. Use <IMG>CYCLEWEAPON<> to change weapon mode. Press <IMG>SHIPFIRE<> to fire.

UT_SHIPSHOT.Name: UT_SHIPSHOT_NAME
UT_SHIPSHOT.Subtitle: UT_SHIPSHOT_SUB
UT_SHIPSHOT.Description_Text:
Overhauls the firing mechanism of the <TECHNOLOGY>Positron Ejector<>, resulting in faster, more accurate particles.

Improves <STELLAR>range<> and <STELLAR>accuracy<>.

SHIPMINIGUN.Name: SHIPMINIGUN_NAME
SHIPMINIGUN.Subtitle: SHIPMINIGUN_SUBTITLE
SHIPMINIGUN.Description_Text: A rapid fire<> starship weapon that launches superheated globes of liquid metal at hostile targets. These projectiles are extremely effective<> against unshielded<> starship hulls. Note: the Accelerator's internal components are vulnerable to rapid overheating<>. Sustained burst fire is not recommended. Use CYCLEWEAPON<> to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE<> to fire.

UT_SHIPMINI.Name: UT_SHIPMINI_NAME
UT_SHIPMINI.Subtitle: UT_SHIPMINI_SUB
UT_SHIPMINI.Description_Text: Upgrades the <TECHNOLOGY>Infra-Knife Accelerator<>, compressing internal waveforms to allow an extra shot to be weaved in to the conventional fire patterns.

SHIPPLASMA.Name: SHIPBLOB_NAME
SHIPPLASMA.Subtitle: SHIPBLOB_SUBTITLE
SHIPPLASMA.Description_Text: A powerful ship-to-ship weapon, flinging plasmatic balls of ionising radiation towards the selected target. These projectiles can disable starship engines<>, leaving the target vulnerable to attack from other weapons. These charged particles are extremely effective<> against starship shields<>, and considerably weaker against the metal armour of a ship's hull. Use CYCLEWEAPON<> to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE<> to fire.

UT_SHIPBLOB.Name: UT_SHIPBLOB_NAME
UT_SHIPBLOB.Subtitle: UT_SHIPBLOB_SUB
UT_SHIPBLOB.Description_Text:
Replaces the heat sink of the <TECHNOLOGY>Cyclotron Ballista<> by encompassing the entire unit with a heat-absorbing megastructure. Heat output is recycled to boost combat efficiency.

Significantly improves <STELLAR>heat performance<>.

F_HYPERDRIVE.Name: UI_FREIGHTER_DRIVE_NAME
F_HYPERDRIVE.Subtitle: UI_FREIGHTER_DRIVE_SUB
F_HYPERDRIVE.Description_Text: FTL propulsion drive that allows starship to attain warp speed and jump between neighbouring systems.

F_HDRIVEBOOST1.Name: UI_FREIGHTER_DRIVE1_NAME
F_HDRIVEBOOST1.Subtitle: UI_FREIGHTER_DRIVE1_SUB
F_HDRIVEBOOST1.Description_Text:
An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an <STELLAR>interstellar freighter<>.

Quantum resonation improves the robustness of the drive during FTL travel, granting the ability to leap to stars previously out of reach.

F_HDRIVEBOOST2.Name: UI_FREIGHTER_DRIVE2_NAME
F_HDRIVEBOOST2.Subtitle: UI_FREIGHTER_DRIVE2_SUB
F_HDRIVEBOOST2.Description_Text:
An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an <STELLAR>interstellar freighter<>.

Hyperdrive benefits from advanced fusion that brings starship to higher warp speed and intensity. User's craft will become able to leap deeper into space, and into more distant planetary systems.

F_HDRIVEBOOST3.Name: UI_FREIGHTER_DRIVE3_NAME
F_HDRIVEBOOST3.Subtitle: UI_FREIGHTER_DRIVE3_SUB
F_HDRIVEBOOST3.Description_Text:
An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an <STELLAR>interstellar freighter<>.

Uncapped, yet stabilised, fusion systems are threaded into user's hyperdrive. Allows starship to jump ever longer distances in deep space.

F_HACCESS1.Name: RGB_WARP_1_NAME
F_HACCESS1.Subtitle: HYP_ACCESS1_SUB
F_HACCESS1.Description_Text:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's core bounding magnets, preventing rapid disassembly when attempting to reach rare-class <FUEL>red stellar bodies<>.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the <VAL_ON>Galactic Map<>.

F_HACCESS2.Name: RGB_WARP_2_NAME
F_HACCESS2.Subtitle: HYP_ACCESS2_SUB
F_HACCESS2.Description_Text:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's shield integrity, preventing reality glitches when attempting to reach rare-class <TRADEABLE>green stellar bodies<>.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the <VAL_ON>Galactic Map<>.

F_HACCESS4.Subtitle: HYP_ACCESS4_SUB

F_TELEPORT.Name: FREIGHTER_TELEPORT_NAME
F_TELEPORT.Subtitle: FREIGHTER_TELEPORT_SUB
F_TELEPORT.Description_Text:
A device that modulates standard freighter communication signals to enable the <TECHNOLOGY>interplanetary transport of matter<> as well as data.

Freighters fitted with such a device can send and receive products and substances to a user's <STELLAR>Exosuit<> over a <STELLAR>long distance<>.

F_SCANNER.Name: UI_FREI_SCAN_NAME
F_SCANNER.Subtitle: UI_FREI_SCAN_SUB
F_SCANNER.Description_Text:
An upgrade to the freighter's <TECHNOLOGY>galactic-scale sensors<>.

This device allows the user to access <STELLAR>detailed economic and conflict data<> for a system, even without having previously visited.

F_MEGAWARP.Name: UI_FREI_MEGAWARP_NAME
F_MEGAWARP.Subtitle: UI_FREI_MEGAWARP_SUB
F_MEGAWARP.Description_Text:
An unstable and highly-experimental piece of <TECHNOLOGY>freighter hyperdrive technology<>. This extreme gravity device generates a <SPECIAL>wormhole<> deep within the freighter's reactor core, inverting the entire vessel and transporting it across the universe.

Speak to the <STELLAR>freighter's commander<> to engage the drive. <FUEL>Warning<>: destination is not controllable.

F_LIFESUPP.Name: UI_FREI_LIFESUPP_NAME
F_LIFESUPP.Subtitle: UI_FREI_LIFESUPP_SUB
F_LIFESUPP.Description_Text:
A critical freighter subsystem, vital for maintaining a habitable and safe environment for all on-board organic lifeforms.

Capable of generated a limited <STELLAR>breathable atmosphere<> even when damaged or unpowered, but only for a short period of time.

SHIPJUMP_ALIEN.Name: SHIPJUMP_ALIEN_NAME
SHIPJUMP_ALIEN.Subtitle: UI_ALIENSHIP_TECH_SUB
SHIPJUMP_ALIEN.Description_Text: A fibrous metallic superstructure binds this warm and vital organ with the core of the ship. Without it, the ship would be nothing, a lifeless husk. Hold PULSEJUMP<> to ask the heart to initiate a Pulse Jump. Hold BOOST<> to request a speed boost.

LAUNCHER_ALIEN.Name: LAUNCHER_ALIEN_NAME
LAUNCHER_ALIEN.Subtitle: UI_ALIENSHIP_TECH_SUB
LAUNCHER_ALIEN.Description_Text: An array of distributed neurons, fused to a board of metallic strands. Complex patterns of electrical impulses weave their way across the surface, knotting each ship system together. Hold THRUST<> to inquire if the ship would like to take off.

WARP_ALIEN.Name: ION1_ALIEN_NAME
WARP_ALIEN.Subtitle: UI_ALIENSHIP_TECH_SUB
WARP_ALIEN.Description_Text:
A complex bio-metallic stem plugged directly into an antimatter heart. Registers high activity during interstellar jumps. It appears to delight in the complex calculations required for FTL travel.

Access long-distance navigation systems through Galactic Map. Keep the ship happy by regularly jumping between systems.

SHIELD_ALIEN.Name: SHIPSHIELD_ALIEN_NAME
SHIELD_ALIEN.Subtitle: UI_ALIENSHIP_TECH_SUB
SHIELD_ALIEN.Description_Text:
This small extension to the ship's automated defense network appears to be its own autonomous organism. A small mouth in the centre of its flesh hungers for <SPECIAL>Pugneum<>.

During combat, it seems to hijack the neurological array and prevent fear or pain from traumatising the rest of the ship's body.

SHIPGUN_ALIEN.Name: SHIPGUN1_ALIEN_NAME
SHIPGUN_ALIEN.Subtitle: UI_ALIENSHIP_TECH_SUB
SHIPGUN_ALIEN.Description_Text: A mess of sacs and sphincters, these vents generate and expel globules of plasma. When fused to the weapon systems of the ship, these are super-heated and then expelled at high-pressure. Press SHIPFIRE<> to ask if the ship would direct its vents towards the current target.

SHIPLAS_ALIEN.Name: SHIPLAS1_ALIEN_NAME
SHIPLAS_ALIEN.Subtitle: UI_ALIENSHIP_TECH_SUB
SHIPLAS_ALIEN.Description_Text: A complex arrangement of membranes and lens, fused atop a high-energy laser array. Incineration awaits those that meet their stare. Press SHIPFIRE<> request the eyes gaze upon nearby targets.

CARGO_S_ALIEN.Name: UI_CARGO_S_ALIEN_NAME
CARGO_S_ALIEN.Subtitle: UI_CARGO_S_ALIEN_SUB
CARGO_S_ALIEN.Description_Text: A beautiful living weave of nanotubes, laced through the vessel's neural assembly. This structure can be energised as the ship deems fit, creating a field that blocks<> hostile cargo probes<>. Use the Quick Menu<> (QUICK_MENU<>) while a scan is in progress to ask that the ship might block the scan.

CHARGER_ALIEN.Name: UI_CHARGER_ALIEN_NAME
CHARGER_ALIEN.Subtitle: UI_CHARGER_ALIEN_SUB
CHARGER_ALIEN.Description_Text:
An infusion of cyanobacteria fills the membrane, which rests just beneath the ship's translucent dermal layer.

The membrane will <STELLAR>recharge the Neural Assembly automatically<> when exposed to sunlight.

SHIPSCAN_ALIEN.Name: UI_SHIPSCAN_ALIEN_NAME
SHIPSCAN_ALIEN.Subtitle: UI_SHIPSCAN_ALIEN_SUB
SHIPSCAN_ALIEN.Description_Text:
The wormhole brain permits the ship <TECHNOLOGY>vision of systems far beyond its own experience<>.  It consists of strands of neural matter, wrapped around a micro-singularity and tethered directly to the ship's visual cortex.

<STELLAR>Detailed economic and conflict data<> will become available on the Galaxy Map, should the ship permit it.

WATERLAND_ALIEN.Name: UI_WATERLAND_ALIEN_NAME
WATERLAND_ALIEN.Subtitle: UI_WATERLAND_ALIEN_SUB
WATERLAND_ALIEN.Description_Text:
A salty membrane encases the ship, dramatically increasing its natural buoyancy.

The carapace will allow the vessel to <TECHNOLOGY>float<>, making <STELLAR>water landings<> possible.

TELEPORT_ALIEN.Name: UI_TELEPORT_ALIEN_NAME
TELEPORT_ALIEN.Subtitle: UI_TELEPORT_ALIEN_SUB
TELEPORT_ALIEN.Description_Text:
Filaments of sinew and neuron warp and weave across the ship, their complex geometry darting between the visible world and some unfathomable dimension beyond.

These tendrils reach across time and space, searching out a <TECHNOLOGY>long-distance link<> between the vessel and their target's Exosuit inventory.

T_BOBBLE_APOLLO.Subtitle: UI_BOBBLE_SUB
T_BOBBLE_APOLLO.Description_Text:

T_SHIP_RAINBOW.Name: UI_SHIPTRAIL_RAINBOW_NAME
T_SHIP_RAINBOW.Subtitle: UI_SHIPTRAIL_SUB
T_SHIP_RAINBOW.Description_Text:
An exclusive <STELLAR>Starship Exhaust Modifier<>.

Precisely calibrated multi-chromatic injectors alter the Pulse Engine's output, turning the exhaust trail into a vibrant display of colour.

Install this <TECHNOLOGY>technology<> in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

T_SHIP_DARK.Name: UI_SHIPTRAIL_DARK_NAME
T_SHIP_DARK.Subtitle: UI_SHIPTRAIL_SUB
T_SHIP_DARK.Description_Text:

Baryon suppressors alter the Pulse Engine's output, giving a distinct black tint to its signature trail.

T_SHIP_GREEN.Name: UI_SHIPTRAIL_GREEN_NAME

T_SHIP_PIRATE.Name: UI_SHIPTRAIL_PIRATE_NAME
T_SHIP_PIRATE.Subtitle: UI_SHIPTRAIL_SUB
T_SHIP_PIRATE.Description_Text:
An exclusive <STELLAR>Starship Exhaust Modifier<>.

A ramshackle ship exhaust nozzle, hand-assembled in an emergency by an outlaw. Has an occasional propensity to explode, but with no adverse effect on flight handling.

Install this <TECHNOLOGY>technology<> in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

T_SHIP_ROGUE.Name: UI_SHIPTRAIL_ROGUE_NAME
T_SHIP_ROGUE.Subtitle: UI_SHIPTRAIL_SUB
T_SHIP_ROGUE.Description_Text:
An exclusive <STELLAR>Starship Exhaust Modifier<>.

A cosmic resonance chamber interacts with starship exhaust, modifying propulsion energy to leave a streak of temporal disturbances.

Install this <TECHNOLOGY>technology<> in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

LAUNCHER_SPEC.Name: LAUNCHER_SPEC_NAME
LAUNCHER_SPEC.Subtitle: LAUNCHER_SPEC_SUB
LAUNCHER_SPEC.Description_Text: A custom-made launch control<> system for high-performance starships. Sensitive gyroscopes and specialised control circuits plot custom take-off routines for increased launch speed<> and efficiency<>. Specialised, deuterium-derived fuel<> is required to recharge thruster. Launch procedures require sufficient fuel levels before activation. Hold THRUST<> to take off from planet. Hold BOOST<> to initiate in-flight speed boost.

SHIPJUMP_SPEC.Name: SHIPJUMP_SPEC_NAME
SHIPJUMP_SPEC.Subtitle: SHIPJUMP_SPEC_SUB
SHIPJUMP_SPEC.Description_Text: A highly-tuned version of the conventional starship Pulse Engine<>. Wavefront occupancy has been pushed to the limit, creating a pulse experience that is both efficient<> and highly responsive<>. User is advised that Tritium<> is required to charge the drive. Tritium is abundant in near-space asteroid fields<>. Scan (SHIPSCAN<>) to search for tritium-rich asteroids<>. Hold PULSEJUMP<> to engage Pulse Jump. Hold BOOST<> to initiate in-flight speed boost.

HYPERDRIVE_SPEC.Name: ION1_SPEC_NAME
HYPERDRIVE_SPEC.Subtitle: ION1_SPEC_SUB
HYPERDRIVE_SPEC.Description_Text:
This experimental drive augments conventional <TECHNOLOGY>hyperdrive<> technology by distorting local geometry at the point of warp initialisation, boosting <STELLAR>range<> and <STELLAR>efficiency<> far beyond standard drives.

User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems through the <STELLAR>Galactic Map<>.

SHIP_LIFESUP.Name: SHIP_LIFESUPPORT_SPEC_NAME
SHIP_LIFESUP.Subtitle: SHIP_LIFESUPPORT_SUB
SHIP_LIFESUP.Description_Text:
A critical starship safety feature, vital for extra-orbital flight.

The pressuration capsule is a dedicated unit that both ensures a <STELLAR>breathable atmosphere<> and prevents the catastrophic explosion of unconventional cockpit designs.

SOLAR_SAIL.Name: UI_SOLAR_SAIL_NAME
SOLAR_SAIL.Subtitle: UI_SOLAR_SAIL_SUB
SOLAR_SAIL.Description_Text:
A high-performance <STELLAR>solar sail<>, deployed automatically during flight. This advanced <TECHNOLOGY>propulsion device<> generates an electric field within the sails themselves, allowing the starship to build momentum from the solar wind.

Offers substantial gains in <STELLAR>fuel efficiency<> and <STELLAR>boost<> performance over conventional engine systems, as well as enabling photovoltaic <STELLAR>recharge<> of the starship's <TECHNOLOGY>launch systems<>.

LAUNCHER_ROBO.Name: UI_LAUNCHER_ROBO_NAME
LAUNCHER_ROBO.Subtitle: UI_LAUNCHER_ROBO_SUB
LAUNCHER_ROBO.Description_Text: Gently detaches the starship from gravitational fields, lifting it toward the stars. The well hungers for pugneum<> or radiant shards<>, and must be sufficiently fueled before launch. Hold THRUST<> to take off from planet. Hold BOOST<> to initiate in-flight speed boost.

SHIPJUMP_ROBO.Name: UI_SHIPJUMP_ROBO_NAME
SHIPJUMP_ROBO.Subtitle: UI_SHIPJUMP_ROBO_SUB
SHIPJUMP_ROBO.Description_Text: Aligns the ship's electromagnetic emissions with A T L A S<> waves, providing basic propulsion and Pulse Jump capability. The sub-light drive hungers for tritium<> or radiant shards<>. Hold PULSEJUMP<> to engage Pulse Jump. Hold BOOST<> to initiate in-flight speed boost.

HYPERDRIVE_ROBO.Name: UI_HYPERDRIVE_ROBO_NAME
HYPERDRIVE_ROBO.Subtitle: UI_HYPERDRIVE_ROBO_SUB
HYPERDRIVE_ROBO.Description_Text:
A raw optic organ, red and unblinking. Suspended above the ship's engines, it gazes down tunnels in spacetime, allowing FTL travel between star systems.

Direct the core's attention to remote destinations via the Galactic Map.

SHIPSHIELD_ROBO.Name: UI_SHIPSHIELD_ROBO_NAME
SHIPSHIELD_ROBO.Subtitle: UI_SHIPSHIELD_ROBO_SUB
SHIPSHIELD_ROBO.Description_Text:
A defensive crimson cocoon, obfuscating the ship's physical form and providing protection from collision and laser fire.

The core self-heals over time, but may be quickly replenished with <CATALYST>catalytic elements<> or <SPECIAL>radiant shards<>.

SHIPGUN_ROBO.Name: UI_SHIPGUN_ROBO_NAME
SHIPGUN_ROBO.Subtitle: UI_SHIPGUN_ROBO_SUB
SHIPGUN_ROBO.Description_Text: Sentinel-grade weapons system, engineered for the singular purpose of annihilating rogue ships in violation of system regulations. Press SHIPFIRE<> to administer lethal force.

LIFESUP_ROBO.Name: UI_LIFESUP_ROBO_NAME
LIFESUP_ROBO.Subtitle: UI_LIFESUP_ROBO_SUB
LIFESUP_ROBO.Description_Text:
This device allows a pilot's brain to <SPECIAL>interface<> with the mind of the Sentinel Interceptor, granting the pilot access to ship control systems and external sensors.

The enmeshing of the pilot's mind with that of the vessel is necessary to prevent <FUEL>rejection<>/<SPECIAL>consumption<> of the pilot by the ship's vestigial cockpit.
LIFESUP_ROBO.DamagedDescriptionText:
The Sentinel vessel has its own mind, its own way of being. It <FUEL>rejects<> the control of an outside entity.

It appears there has been a previous attempt to cut out the ship's brain and make its vestigial cockpit habitable, handing control of the ship to a conventional pilot. Complete this installation to <STELLAR>claim the ship<>.

SCANBINOC1.Name: SCANBINOC1_NAME
SCANBINOC1.Subtitle: SCANBINOC1_SUBTITLE
SCANBINOC1.Description_Text: Specialist Discovery<> and Survey<> unit. Augments standard Scanner<> capabilities by projecting detailed environmental data directly over the user's visor. Allows the identification of distant points of interest<>. The Visor will generate valuable data<> when used to study flora<>, fauna<> and minerals<>. Hold AIM<> to operate. Press ZOOM<> to zoom.
SCANBINOC1.DamagedDescriptionText:
The Analysis Visor is a planetary <TECHNOLOGY>exploration device<> that locates and <TECHNOLOGY>highlights nearby points of interest<>.

It can also be used to analyse <TRADEABLE>flora<>, <FUEL>fauna<> and <TECHNOLOGY>minerals<>. Analysis results in <COMMODITY>commercially valuable data<>, as well as revealing <TECHNOLOGY>additional resources<>.

SCAN1.Name: SCAN1_NAME
SCAN1.Subtitle: SCAN1_SUBTITLE
SCAN1.Description_Text: A Personal Surface Radar<> augmentation for the Multi-Tool. The Scanner releases a high-energy pulse that reveals any critical survival resources<> in the immediate area. Data is transmitted via the Exosuit directly into the user's visual nervous system. Press SCAN<> to activate a local scan.
SCAN1.DamagedDescriptionText: The scanner is a <TECHNOLOGY>personal surface radar<> device. It releases a high-energy pulse that reveals any <COMMODITY>critical survival resources<> in the immediate area.

UT_SCAN.Name: UT_SCAN_NAME
UT_SCAN.Subtitle: UT_SCAN_SUB
UT_SCAN.Description_Text:
A powerful lateral processor inserted into the Multi-Tool <TECHNOLOGY>Scanning System<> allows the device to recharge at a significantly improved rate.

Increases <STELLAR>potential scan frequency<>.

UT_SURVEY.Name: UT_SURVEY_NAME
UT_SURVEY.Subtitle: UT_SURVEY_SUB
UT_SURVEY.Description_Text: A self-contained circuitry upgrade for the Analysis Visor<>, adding real-time terrain analysis to the scanning array. Toggle between Visor modes with SURVEYFILTERL<>/SURVEYFILTERR<>. Use Surveying Mode<> to detect hidden terrain resources.

UT_BUI_SCAN.Name: UI_BUI_SCAN_NAME
UT_BUI_SCAN.Subtitle: UI_BUI_SCAN_SUB
UT_BUI_SCAN.Description_Text: An attachment for the Multi-Tool Scanner<> that allows the device to detect and decode the cloaking signal of nearby Autophage units. Use SCAN<> to activate the Scanner. As its detector waveform passes over the local area, it will automatically reveal<> any nearby Autophage entities<>.

UT_BUI_SCAN2.Name: UI_BUI_SCAN2_NAME
UT_BUI_SCAN2.Subtitle: UI_BUI_SCAN2_SUB
UT_BUI_SCAN2.Description_Text: An attachment for the Multi-Tool Scanner<> that allows the device to detect and decode the cloaking signal of nearby Autophage units. Use SCAN<> to activate the Scanner. As its detector waveform passes over the local area, it will automatically reveal<> any nearby Autophage entities<>. In addition, this device can be used to locate Autophage gatherings<>. Use Locate Autophage Camp<> (FE_SELECT<>)<> to pinpoint a planetary gathering of Autophage.

UT_S10_SCAN.Name: UI_UT_S10_SCAN_NAME
UT_S10_SCAN.Subtitle: UI_UT_S10_SCAN_SUB
UT_S10_SCAN.Description_Text: An attachment for the Multi-Tool Scanner<>, designed by Specialist Polo for the detection of atlantideum-infused sentience echoes<>. On dissonant<> worlds, use the Analysis Visor (AIM<>) to locate sentience echoes. On arrival at an echo site, use SCAN<> to fully reveal<> nearby anomalies.

TERRAINEDITOR.Name: UI_TERRAIN_EDIT_NAME
TERRAINEDITOR.Subtitle: UI_TERRAIN_EDIT_SUBTITLE
TERRAINEDITOR.Description_Text:
Advanced terraforming device. This module overloads existing multi-tool systems, allowing the user to reshape regions as they wish.

Charged with <EARTH>metallic elements<>.

GROUND_SHIELD.Name: GROUND_SHIELD_NAME
GROUND_SHIELD.Subtitle: GROUND_SHIELD_SUB
GROUND_SHIELD.Description_Text:
On activation, this module draws power from <VAL_ON>Exosuit Life Support<> systems to overload the Multi-Tool, distorting the electromagnetic field around the user and creating a <COMMODITY>powerful personal shield<>.

While this field offers substantial protection against incoming laser fire, the user is advised that the Multi-Tool cannot be used for other functions while powering the shield.

STEALTH.Name: UI_STEALTH_NAME
STEALTH.Subtitle: UI_STEALTH_SUB
STEALTH.Description_Text:
On activation, this module draws power from <VAL_ON>Exosuit Life Support<> systems to manipulate the gravitational field around the user, refracting the light and creating an <STELLAR>active camouflage effect<>.

This <STELLAR>temporary<> effect can be used to escape unwanted hostile attention. WARNING: active camouflage will be aborted upon dramatic Exosuit maneuvers such as jetpack activation, or by activating Multi-Tool weapons systems.

SCOPE.Name: SCOPE_NAME
SCOPE.Subtitle: SCOPE_SUB
SCOPE.Description_Text: A recoil-stabilising weapon scope for precise combat.

LASER.Name: LASER_NAME
LASER.Subtitle: LASER_SUBTITLE
LASER.Description_Text: Multi-Tool Mining Beam<> powered by Carbon-based Elements<>. Fire the beam with ATTACK<>. Installs focusing optics within the Multi-Tool, allowing it to emit a high-energy beam<>. The beam is calibrated to excite molecules within common organic or geological objects<>, allowing it to operate as a highly effective mining device. WARNING<>: Destruction of flora, fauna or minerals may attract Sentinel attention.

STRONGLASER.Name: STRONGLASER_NAME
STRONGLASER.Subtitle: STRONGLASER_SUBTITLE
STRONGLASER.Description_Text:
Replaces standard <TECHNOLOGY>Mining Beam<> optics with high-grade Living Glass, allowing the beam to be effective against <STELLAR>large and/or rare resource deposits<>.

The lens adapts automatically to minute fluctuations in the beam waveform, minimising scatter and <STELLAR>increasing device mining potential<>.

UT_MINER.Name: UT_MINER_NAME
UT_MINER.Subtitle: UT_MINER_SUB
UT_MINER.Description_Text:
Wafer-thin lens arrays are arranged in a highly calibrated matrix, focusing the <TECHNOLOGY>Mining Beam<> on an atomic level.

This extra precision allows for highly efficient mining. Elements are extracted more efficiently, <STELLAR>increasing the yield<> from items harvested with the Multi-Tool.

FISHLASER.Name: UI_FISHLASER_NAME
FISHLASER.Subtitle: UI_FISHLASER_SUB
FISHLASER.Description_Text: A versatile piece of angling equipment<>, enabling the user to fish<> in a variety of water conditions. Access the fishing rig by pressing CYCLEWEAPON<> and cast your line into a body of water with ATTACK<>. With a fish hooked, press and hold ATTACK<> to haul in your catch.

S15_FISHLASER.Name: UI_S15_FISHLASER_NAME
S15_FISHLASER.Subtitle: UI_S15_FISHLASER_SUB
S15_FISHLASER.Description_Text: A versatile piece of angling equipment<>, enabling the user to fish<> in a variety of water conditions. This rig was once owned by the legendary Lost Angler<>. Access the fishing rig by pressing CYCLEWEAPON<> and cast your line into a body of water with ATTACK<>. With a fish hooked, press and hold ATTACK<> to haul in your catch.

BOLT.Name: BOLT_NAME
BOLT.Subtitle: BOLT_SUBTITLE
BOLT.Description_Text: Generalist weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool<>. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON<> and fire weapon with ATTACK<>. The Boltcaster<> reconfigures the Multi-Tool to supercharge Metallic Elements<>, firing them as high-velocity projectiles<> capable of causing extreme damage.

UT_BOLT.Name: UT_BOLT_NAME
UT_BOLT.Subtitle: UT_BOLT_SUB
UT_BOLT.Description_Text:
Inserts a powerful field ionisation device into the barrel of the <TECHNOLOGY>Boltcaster<>, increasing projectile stability through the air.

Improves <STELLAR>device accuracy<> and allows the user to fire for longer periods without degrading combat performance.

UT_BOLTBOUNCE.Name: UT_BOLTBOUNCE_NAME
UT_BOLTBOUNCE.Subtitle: UT_BOLT_SUB
UT_BOLTBOUNCE.Description_Text:
Creates an antimatter field around the shots of the <TECHNOLOGY>Boltcaster<>, causing them to be repelled by non-damaged surfaces.

Enables <STELLAR>ricochet<>, causing projectiles to bounce if they hit a target they do not damage.

BOLT_SM.Name: BOLT_SM_NAME
BOLT_SM.Subtitle: BOLTDMG1_SUBTITLE
BOLT_SM.Description_Text:
Boltcaster shots deliver added physical damage upon impact.

Grants additional kinetic energy to the user's ionised plasma distribution systems.

Operates automatically once constructed within user's Multi-Tool inventory.

LASER_XO.Name: LASER_XO_NAME
LASER_XO.Subtitle: UP_LASER1_SUB
LASER_XO.Description_Text:
A <TECHNOLOGY>significant<> upgrade for the <TECHNOLOGY>Mining Beam<>.

Upgrades the Mining Laser's primary crystal chamber, boosting core <STELLAR>beam energy<> while decreasing unwanted <STELLAR>heat spill<>.

GRENADE.Name: GRENADE_NAME
GRENADE.Subtitle: GRENADE_SUBTITLE
GRENADE.Description_Text: High-impact projectile weapon. Launched plasma shells bounce off surfaces until their internal timer triggers a large explosion. Charged with Unstable Plasma<>. Careless use can result in damage to user. Press ALTATTACK<> to activate.

TERRAIN_GREN.Name: T_GRENADE_NAME
TERRAIN_GREN.Subtitle: T_GRENADE_SUB
TERRAIN_GREN.Description_Text: Large-bore projectile launcher. Propels plasma shells designed for rapid ground excavation<>. Charged with Unstable Plasma<>. Warning: Explosive hole creation may also damage nearby organic matter. Press ALTATTACK<> to activate.

STUN_GREN.Name: STUN_GRENADE_NAME
STUN_GREN.Subtitle: STUN_GRENADE_SUB
STUN_GREN.Description_Text: Non-violent projectile weapon. Launched projectiles will incapacitate nearby targets with a burst of electrical energy. Effective against both biological and electronic entities. Charged with Unstable Plasma<>. Press ALTATTACK<> to activate.

RAILGUN.Name: RAILGUN1_NAME
RAILGUN.Subtitle: RAILGUN1_SUBTITLE
RAILGUN.Description_Text: Aggressive weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool<>. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON<> and fire weapon with ATTACK<>. The Blaze Javelin delivers instantaneous damage on targets. Plasma charge process creates an ionised gas arc to propel projectiles at great speed. User will perceive destructive results simultaneous to the pull of the trigger.

UT_RAIL.Name: UT_RAIL_NAME
UT_RAIL.Subtitle: UT_RAIL_SUB
UT_RAIL.Description_Text:
Extends the firing chamber of the <TECHNOLOGY>Blaze Javelin<>, allowing the internal particle accelerators to reach both greater mass and speed.

Significantly improves <STELLAR>weapon damage<>.

UT_RAIL_STUN.Name: UT_RAIL_STUN_NAME
UT_RAIL_STUN.Subtitle: UT_RAIL_SUB
UT_RAIL_STUN.Description_Text:
Overloads the energy beam generated by the <TECHNOLOGY>Blaze Javelin<>, causing it to deliver a power electrical charge at its point of impact.

Will briefly <STELLAR>stun<> any organic and inorganic entities that intersect the Blaze Javelin's beam.

SHOTGUN.Name: BOLTSHOTGUN_NAME
SHOTGUN.Subtitle: BOLTSHOTGUN_SUBTITLE
SHOTGUN.Description_Text: Specialist close combat<> weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool<>. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON<> and fire weapon with ATTACK<>. The Scatter Blaster<> reconfigures the Multi-Tool to heat and shatter Metallic Elements<>, firing them in a wide cone of destruction<>. Range is limited, but the shrapnel is highly effective at close range.

UT_SHOT.Name: UT_SHOT_NAME
UT_SHOT.Subtitle: UT_SHOT_SUB
UT_SHOT.Description_Text: Advanced self-lubricating components decrease friction within the <TECHNOLOGY>Scatter Blaster<>, offering significant improvements to <STELLAR>reload times<>.

SMG.Name: BOLTSMG_NAME
SMG.Subtitle: BOLTSMG_SUBTITLE
SMG.Description_Text: Specialist rapid fire<> weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool<>. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON<> and fire weapon with ATTACK<>. The Pulse Spitter<> redirects Multi-Tool optics to ionise inserted Metallic Elements<>. These projectiles are launched in a rapid-fire spread, bombarding potential targets with a wave of high-energy plasma<>.

UT_SMG.Name: UT_SMG_NAME
UT_SMG.Subtitle: UT_SMG_SUB
UT_SMG.Description_Text:
Specialist harmonic resonators allow the <TECHNOLOGY>Pulse Spitter<> to split inserted ammunition, effective manufacturing more shots from fewer materials.

Increases <STELLAR>weapon clip size<>.

UT_SMGBOUNCE.Name: UT_SMGBOUNCE_NAME
UT_SMGBOUNCE.Subtitle: UT_SMG_SUB
UT_SMGBOUNCE.Description_Text:
Creates an antimatter field around the shots of the <TECHNOLOGY>Pulse Spitter<>, causing them to be repelled by non-damaged surfaces.

Enables <STELLAR>ricochet<>, causing projectiles to bounce if they hit a target they do not damage.

UT_SMG_DOT.Name: UT_SMG_DOT_NAME
UT_SMG_DOT.Subtitle: UT_SMG_SUB
UT_SMG_DOT.Description_Text:
A powerful combat upgrade for the <TECHNOLOGY>Pulse Spitter<>. This module installs series of delicately calibrated fuel-injection nozzles within the firing chamber, which are used to initiate a controlled burn within its plasma projectiles.

Causes targets hit by the Pulse Spitter to <STELLAR>burn<> for a short while, causing additional damage.

FLAME.Name: FLAMETHROW_NAME
FLAME.Subtitle: FLAMETHROW_SUBTITLE
FLAME.Description_Text: Specialist high temperature<> weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool<>. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON<> and fire weapon with ATTACK<>. The Incinerator<> focuses internal lasers onto the naturally-occuring exhaust gases generated by the Multi-Tool. Ignition results in a highly destructive, if short range, inferno.

CANNON.Name: CANNON_NAME
CANNON.Subtitle: CANNON_SUBTITLE
CANNON.Description_Text: A high-energy weapon<> attachment for the Multi-Tool<>. The Neutron Cannon energises atmospheric particles before propelling them towards hostile targets, delivering significant area damage<> Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON<>. Charge the weapon with ATTACK<>, then release to unleash a volley of ionised particles<>. While the cannon can deliver instantaneous single shots, longer charges<> will result in significant increases to the speed and volume of released particles<>.

UT_CANNON.Name: UT_CANNON_NAME
UT_CANNON.Subtitle: UT_CANNON_SUBTITLE
UT_CANNON.Description_Text:
A powerful upgrade to the <TECHNOLOGY>Neutron Cannon<>. Additional resonance compressors allow significantly more energy to be routed through the cannon's central core, dramatically increasing operating power.

Installation will allow a fully-charged Neutron Cannon to launch <STELLAR>additional projectiles<> at <STELLAR>higher speeds<>.

UT_STUNDMG.Name: UT_STUNDMG_NAME
UT_STUNDMG.Subtitle: UT_STUNDMG_SUB
UT_STUNDMG.Description_Text:
A generalised upgrade for all Multi-Tool <TECHNOLOGY>weapon systems<>, causing its projectiles to resonate dramatically upon impact with any appropriate electromagnetic field.

Will significantly increase the <STELLAR>damage<> dealt to any organic and inorganic entities that are currently <STELLAR>stunned<>.

WEAPSLOT_DMG1.Subtitle: UI_WEAPSLOT_DMG_SUB
