SUN_LASER.Name: UI_SUN_LASER_NAME
SUN_LASER.Subtitle: UI_SUN_LASER_SUB
SUN_LASER.Description_Text:
A highly specialised addition to the Multi-Tool's mining capabilities, transforming <STELLAR>terrain deposits<> into <STELLAR>liquid sun<>.

A powerful laser array amplifies local solar radiation, allowing for the rapid reconfiguration of nearby mineral ores.

SOUL_LASER.Name: UI_SOUL_LASER_NAME
SOUL_LASER.Subtitle: UI_SOUL_LASER_SUB
SOUL_LASER.Description_Text:
A unique overload to the Multi-Tool's standard mining laser. Beam frequency is modulated precisely in a feedback loop with the delta-waves generated by the impact target.

Recordings of the target's experiences are thus etched into tiny fragments of metal and rendered as <STELLAR>Fragmented Qualia<>. Readability of collected fragments is not guaranteed.

SENT_LASER.Name: UI_SENT_LASER_NAME
SENT_LASER.Subtitle: UI_SENT_LASER_SUB
SENT_LASER.Description_Text: This Multi-Tool is made with material and methods known to no conventional manufacturer, its core a unfathomable array of impossible optics and glassy foam. Nonetheless, there is a layer of recogniseable technology. It shows signs of having been tampered with<> by an unknown craftsman, who has repurposed its scanner array into a high-powered mining laser<>. Powered by Carbon-based Elements<>. Fire the beam with ATTACK<>.

ATLAS_LASER.Name: UI_ATLAS_LASER_NAME
ATLAS_LASER.Subtitle: UI_ATLAS_LASER_SUB
ATLAS_LASER.Description_Text: The geometric heart of this ancient weapon is the Runic Lens<>. Its impossible geometry not only concentrates light into a high-powered Mining Laser<>, but can also warp the local electromagnetic field so as to render the user invisible<>. Powered by Carbon-based Elements<>. Fire the beam with ATTACK<>. Select its secondary cloaking function with CYCLEALTWEAPON<> and hold ALTATTACK<> to activate.

VEHICLE_ENGINE.Name: VEHICLEENGINE_NAME
VEHICLE_ENGINE.Subtitle: VEHICLEENGINE_SUBTITLE
VEHICLE_ENGINE.Description_Text:
A compact fusion core common to all Exocraft.

Requires fuel to function.

VEHICLE_GRIP1.Name: VEHICLE_GRIP1_NAME
VEHICLE_GRIP1.Subtitle: VEHICLE_GRIP_SUB
VEHICLE_GRIP1.Description_Text:
Overhauls Exocraft handling values through a combination of software tweaks, pressure adjustments and the insertion of microgravity wells into key suspension components.

Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the Exocraft to <STELLAR>drift<>.

VEHICLE_GRIP2.Name: VEHICLE_GRIP2_NAME
VEHICLE_GRIP2.Subtitle: VEHICLE_GRIP_SUB
VEHICLE_GRIP2.Description_Text:
Overhauls Exocraft handling values through a combination of software tweaks, pressure adjustments and the insertion of microgravity wells into key suspension components.

Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the Exocraft to <STELLAR>turn sharply<>.

VEHICLE_GRIP3.Name: VEHICLE_GRIP3_NAME
VEHICLE_GRIP3.Subtitle: VEHICLE_GRIP_SUB
VEHICLE_GRIP3.Description_Text:
Overhauls Exocraft handling values through a combination of software tweaks, pressure adjustments and the insertion of microgravity wells into key suspension components.

Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the Exocraft to <STELLAR>slide<>.

EXO_PROT_HOT.Name: UI_EXOHAZ_HEAT_NAME
EXO_PROT_HOT.Subtitle: UI_EXOHAZ_SUB
EXO_PROT_HOT.Description_Text:
Sublimation cooling vents and high-thermal mass buffers are installed in all structural panels, keeping the Exocraft pilot at non-lethal temperatures even in the most overwhelming of firestorms.

Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in <FUEL>scorched environments<>.

EXO_PROT_COLD.Name: UI_EXOHAZ_COLD_NAME
EXO_PROT_COLD.Subtitle: UI_EXOHAZ_SUB
EXO_PROT_COLD.Description_Text:
Installs a powerful heater into the Exocraft, keeping the cabin a habitable temperature even in the most freezing of conditions.

Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in <TEMPERATURE>freezing environments<>.

EXO_PROT_TOX.Name: UI_EXOHAZ_TOX_NAME
EXO_PROT_TOX.Subtitle: UI_EXOHAZ_SUB
EXO_PROT_TOX.Description_Text:
Double-vacuumed air filtration systems allow no trace of the planetary atmosphere into the Exocraft cabin without being thoroughly scrubbed.

Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in <TRADEABLE>toxic environments<>.

EXO_PROT_RAD.Name: UI_EXOHAZ_RAD_NAME
EXO_PROT_RAD.Subtitle: UI_EXOHAZ_SUB
EXO_PROT_RAD.Description_Text:
Highly-efficient control materials are inserted into the frame of the Exocraft, neutralising dangerous incoming energy waves.

Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in <COMMODITY>radioactive environments<>.

EXO_RECHARGE.Name: UI_EXO_RECHARGE_NAME
EXO_RECHARGE.Subtitle: UI_EXO_RECHARGE_SUB
EXO_RECHARGE.Description_Text:
The Icarus system takes advantage of existing metal panelling, upgrading them into photovoltaic surfaces. This reactive coating generates energy during daylight hours, offsetting fuel consumption.

Enables <STELLAR>automatic engine recharging<> during the <STELLAR>day<>.

EXO_REFINER.Name: UI_EXO_REFINER_NAME
EXO_REFINER.Subtitle: UI_EXO_REFINER_SUB
EXO_REFINER.Description_Text:
A large and powerful <TECHNOLOGY>refiner unit<>, designed to be housed within the belly of a <STELLAR>Colossus Exocraft<>.

The unit is able to process the most <TECHNOLOGY>complex recipes<>, but requires its own independent <FUEL>fuel<> source.

VEHICLE_SCAN.Name: VEHICLESCAN_NAME
VEHICLE_SCAN.Subtitle: VEHICLESCAN_SUBTITLE
VEHICLE_SCAN.Description_Text: A large and complex field-based subspace radar. Due to their large power consumption and inherent subatomic instability, they are found only installed on Exocraft. Press QUICK_MENU<> to activate the Signal Booster.

VEHICLE_SCAN1.Name: VEHICLESCAN_U1_NAME
VEHICLE_SCAN1.Subtitle: VEHICLESCAN_U1_SUBTITLE
VEHICLE_SCAN1.Description_Text: Allows for additional building types to be acquired by the Exocraft Radar.

VEHICLE_SCAN2.Name: VEHICLESCAN_U2_NAME
VEHICLE_SCAN2.Subtitle: VEHICLESCAN_U2_SUBTITLE
VEHICLE_SCAN2.Description_Text: Allows for additional building types to be acquired by the Exocraft Radar.

VEHICLE_BOOST.Name: VEHICLEBOOST_NAME
VEHICLE_BOOST.Subtitle: VEHICLEBOOST_SUBTITLE
VEHICLE_BOOST.Description_Text: An efficient plasma injector coupled to the engine that allows short bursts of speed.

VEHICLE_LASER.Name: VEHICLEMINER_NAME
VEHICLE_LASER.Subtitle: VEHICLEMINER_SUBTITLE
VEHICLE_LASER.Description_Text: A mining laser too cumbersome for handheld operation, they are found only installed on Exocraft.

VEHICLE_LASER1.Name: VEHICLEMINER_U1_NAME
VEHICLE_LASER1.Subtitle: VEHICLEMINER_U1_SUBTITLE
VEHICLE_LASER1.Description_Text: Increases power of the Exocraft Mining Laser.

VEHICLE_GUN.Name: VEHICLEWEAPON_NAME
VEHICLE_GUN.Subtitle: VEHICLEWEAPON_SUBTITLE
VEHICLE_GUN.Description_Text: Due to the energy requirements of this powerful weapon, they can only be fired from an Exocraft mount.

VEHICLE_FLAME.Name: UI_EXOCRAFT_FIRE_NAME
VEHICLE_FLAME.Subtitle: UI_EXOCRAFT_FIRE_SUB
VEHICLE_FLAME.Description_Text: A mounted flamethrower<> specifically designed for the Exocraft<>. Causes extreme damage at close range. Use CYCLEWEAPON<> to cycle available weapon modes.

SUB_ENGINE.Name: UI_SUBENGINE_NAME
SUB_ENGINE.Subtitle: VEHICLEENGINE_SUBTITLE
SUB_ENGINE.Description_Text:
A thermally-efficient, inversion-proof reactor engine capable of powering the Nautilon even at extreme depths.

Powered by <FUEL>Hydrothermal Fuel Cells<>.

SUB_GUN.Name: UI_SUBGUN_NAME
SUB_GUN.Subtitle: UI_SUBGUN_SUB
SUB_GUN.Description_Text:
A mounted cannon specifically designed for the <STELLAR>Nautilon Submarine<>.

A high-energy weapon system, it superheats a small body of water before launching it rapidly towards the intended target.

Designed primarily for damage against biological entities and inefficient when deployed as a mining device.

SUB_LASER.Name: UI_SUBLASER_NAME
SUB_LASER.Subtitle: UI_SUBLASER_SUB
SUB_LASER.Description_Text:
A mounted laser system specifically designed for the <STELLAR>Nautilon Submarine<>.

Fires a concentrated plasma beam towards the intended target, which is then ignited. Such a trigger mechanism allows the use of high-energy optical mining systems in a liquid medium.

SUB_MINER.Name: UI_SUB_MINER_NAME
SUB_MINER.Subtitle: UI_SUB_MINER_SUB
SUB_MINER.Description_Text:
Adds <STELLAR>Terrain Manipulation<> capability to the laser systems of the <STELLAR>Nautilon Submarine<>.

Cooled by specially designed water intakes, it is specifically calibrated to carve through the complex geology of the sea floor.

SUB_BINOCS.Name: UI_SUB_BINOCS_NAME
SUB_BINOCS.Subtitle: UI_SUB_BINOCS_SUB
SUB_BINOCS.Description_Text: A high-detail sonar device, capable of upgrading the scanner technology aboard a Nautilon-class submarine to Analysis Visor<> levels, pinning to the HUD all information typically revealed by the Analysis Visor. Press SCAN<> to activate the High-Power Sonar.

SUB_RECHARGE.Name: UI_SUB_RECHARGE_NAME
SUB_RECHARGE.Subtitle: UI_SUB_RECHARGE_SUB
SUB_RECHARGE.Description_Text:
Installed into the drive system aboard the <STELLAR>Nautilon Submarine<>.

Captures energy by exploiting the saline gradient in deep water environments, allowing a slow recharge of the <TECHNOLOGY>Humboldt Drive<> in the event of fuel emergencies.

MECH_ENGINE.Name: UI_MECH_ENGINE_NAME
MECH_ENGINE.Subtitle: UI_MECH_ENGINE_SUB
MECH_ENGINE.Description_Text:
A compact reactor unit, this engine is the heart of the Minotaur. It is mounted on a gyroscope to prevent fuel incidents during rapid movement.

Powered by conventional <FUEL>carbon-base fuels<>.

MECH_FUEL.Name: UI_MECH_FUEL_NAME
MECH_FUEL.Subtitle: UI_MECH_FUEL_SUB
MECH_FUEL.Description_Text:
An automatically-regulated lubricant dispenser fitted to the leg joints of the Minotaur reduce friction and encourage fuel-efficient motion.

Significantly <STELLAR>reduces fuel burn<> in the Minotaur's Daedalus Engine.

MECH_SCAN.Name: UI_MECH_SCAN_NAME
MECH_SCAN.Subtitle: UI_MECH_SCAN_SUB
MECH_SCAN.Description_Text: A high-detail radar device, capable of upgrading the scanner technology aboard the Minotaur to Analysis Visor levels. Press SCAN<> to activate a radar sweep, revealing additional points of interest<> that cannot be located via a Multi-Tool scanner. Use the Quick Menu to tune the radar to specific buildings<>.

MECH_BOOST.Name: UI_MECH_BOOST_NAME
MECH_BOOST.Subtitle: UI_MECH_BOOST_SUB
MECH_BOOST.Description_Text: A series of agile, high-powered jet thrusters mounted to the rear of the rear of the Minotaur. Precise use allows the Minotaur to quickly and powerfully traverse all manner of terrain. Press and hold JUMP<> to activate. Limited in-flight control is possible.

MECH_LASER.Name: UI_MECH_LASER_NAME
MECH_LASER.Subtitle: UI_MECH_LASER_SUB
MECH_LASER.Description_Text:
A mounted laser system specifically designed for the <STELLAR>Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid<>.

Enables conventional mining operations. Ineffective in combat scenarios.

MECH_LASER1.Name: UI_MECH_LASER1_NAME
MECH_LASER1.Subtitle: UI_MECH_LASER1_SUB
MECH_LASER1.Description_Text:
An upgrade for the <STELLAR>Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid<>'s laser array system.

Amplifies the power deployed by the mining beam, increasing mining speed and enabling the processing of difficult to mine raw materials.

MECH_GUN.Name: UI_MECH_GUN_NAME
MECH_GUN.Subtitle: UI_MECH_GUN_SUB
MECH_GUN.Description_Text:
A mounted cannon specifically designed for the <STELLAR>Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid<>.

Designed primarily for damage against biological entities and inefficient when deployed as a mining device.

MECH_MINER.Name: UI_MECH_MINER_NAME
MECH_MINER.Subtitle: UI_MECH_MINER_SUB
MECH_MINER.Description_Text:
Adds <STELLAR>Terrain Manipulation<> capability to the laser array of the <STELLAR>Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid<>.

A special mount allows the rapid deployment of a high-energy terrain excavator, without risking clogging the Minotaur's delicate joints and servos with dirt.

MECH_PROT.Name: UI_EXOHAZ_ALL_NAME
MECH_PROT.Subtitle: UI_EXOHAZ_SUB
MECH_PROT.Description_Text:
This powerful environmental neutralising system is plugged directly into the pilot as they enter the cockpit. The system is powered via the Minotaur's main engine and requires no additional input. Some minor pain may be noticed around the insertion site.

Renders the Minotaur pilot impervious to <STELLAR>all environmental hazards<>.

MECH_PILOT.Name: UI_MECH_AUTOPILOT_NAME
MECH_PILOT.Subtitle: UI_MECH_AUTOPILOT_SUB
MECH_PILOT.Description_Text:
A semi-autonomous <TECHNOLOGY>artificial pilot plugin<> for the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid. Installation allows the Minotaur to <STELLAR>traverse planets itself<> and engage in <STELLAR>combat<> or <STELLAR>mining<> activities to support its primary operator.

The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit.

Piloting routines are highly localised. It is incapable of developing emotional bonds nor exercising independent control of the Minotaur.

MECH_SENT_L_ARM.Name: UI_MECH_SENT_L_ARM_NAME
MECH_SENT_L_ARM.Subtitle: UI_MECH_SENT_SUB
MECH_SENT_L_ARM.Description_Text:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the <TECHNOLOGY>Minotaur<> Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.

When installed alongside a <TECHNOLOGY>Minotaur Laser<>, it transforms the mining laser into a <STELLAR>powerful combat upgrade<> with the ability to deal heavy damaged to <TECHNOLOGY>stunned<> entities.

MECH_SENT_R_ARM.Name: UI_MECH_SENT_R_ARM_NAME
MECH_SENT_R_ARM.Subtitle: UI_MECH_SENT_SUB
MECH_SENT_R_ARM.Description_Text: A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur<> Heavy Exocraft Hybrid. This limb override also functions as its own dedicated combat system<>. It deploys high-velocity stun projectiles<> and serves as an excellent support weapon to the Minotaur's primary cannon. Use CYCLEWEAPON<> to cycle available weapon modes.

MECH_SENT_LEGS.Name: UI_MECH_SENT_LEGS_NAME
MECH_SENT_LEGS.Subtitle: UI_MECH_SENT_SUB
MECH_SENT_LEGS.Description_Text:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the <TECHNOLOGY>Minotaur<> Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.

Installation will significantly improve the Minotaur's <TECHNOLOGY>engine and mobility<> systems.

MECH_SENT_HEAD.Name: UI_MECH_SENT_HEAD_NAME
MECH_SENT_HEAD.Subtitle: UI_MECH_SENT_HEAD_SUB
MECH_SENT_HEAD.Description_Text:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the <TECHNOLOGY>Minotaur<> Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.

Will function as a semi-autonomous <TECHNOLOGY>artificial pilot plugin<>. Installation allows the Minotaur to <STELLAR>traverse planets itself<> and engage in <STELLAR>combat<> or <STELLAR>mining<> activities to support its primary operator.

The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit.

MECH_ARMY_L_ARM.Name: UI_MECH_ARMY_L_ARM_NAME
MECH_ARMY_L_ARM.Subtitle: UI_MECH_ARMY_SUB
MECH_ARMY_L_ARM.Description_Text:
An upgrade to the <TECHNOLOGY>Minotaur<> Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.

This limb override also functions as its own <STELLAR>dedicated combat system<>. It deploys high-velocity <TECHNOLOGY>stun projectiles<>, perfect for keeping hostiles in place while advancing to close range.

MECH_ARMY_R_ARM.Name: UI_MECH_ARMY_R_ARM_NAME
MECH_ARMY_R_ARM.Subtitle: UI_MECH_ARMY_SUB
MECH_ARMY_R_ARM.Description_Text: An upgrade to the Minotaur<> Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments. This limb override also functions as its own dedicated combat system<> - a flamethrower<> for extreme damage at close range. Use CYCLEWEAPON<> to cycle available weapon modes.

MECH_ARMY_LEGS.Name: UI_MECH_ARMY_LEGS_NAME
MECH_ARMY_LEGS.Subtitle: UI_MECH_ARMY_SUB
MECH_ARMY_LEGS.Description_Text:
An upgrade to the <TECHNOLOGY>Minotaur<> Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.

Installation will significantly improve the Minotaur's <TECHNOLOGY>engine and mobility<> systems.

MECH_ARMY_HEAD.Name: UI_MECH_ARMY_HEAD_NAME
MECH_ARMY_HEAD.Subtitle: UI_MECH_ARMY_SUB
MECH_ARMY_HEAD.Description_Text:
An upgrade to the <TECHNOLOGY>Minotaur<> Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.

Will function as a semi-autonomous <TECHNOLOGY>artificial pilot plugin<>. Installation allows the Minotaur to <STELLAR>traverse planets itself<> and engage in <STELLAR>combat<> or <STELLAR>mining<> activities to support its primary operator.

The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit.

MAINT_FARM1.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_FARM1_NAME
MAINT_FARM1.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_FARM_SUB
MAINT_FARM1.Description_Text: A control unit for a brigade of tiny robots. These are directed to burrow through the soil and eliminate yield-depleting pests. Control unit maintenance is crucial to prevent accidental robot swarms.

MAINT_FARM2.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_FARM2_NAME
MAINT_FARM2.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_FARM_SUB
MAINT_FARM2.Description_Text: An automatic sprinkler system that tunes itself to the needs of the plants, deploying water as a fine mist, a heavy downpour, or anything in-between.

MAINT_FARM3.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_FARM3_NAME
MAINT_FARM3.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_FARM_SUB
MAINT_FARM3.Description_Text: A bank of LEDs controlled by a photosensitive processing unit, designed to carefully deliver exactly the mix of red, green or blue light that the plant requires.

MAINT_FARM4.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_FARM4_NAME
MAINT_FARM4.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_FARM_SUB
MAINT_FARM4.Description_Text: This advanced bank of lasers prunes and propagates plants as required, the cauterising light offering unequaled precision.

MAINT_FARM5.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_FARM5_NAME
MAINT_FARM5.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_FARM_SUB
MAINT_FARM5.Description_Text: A hybrid fabricator/distributor that tests the soil for missing nutrients, so that it can create and spray the perfect fertiliser.

MAINT_FUEL1.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_FUEL1_NAME
MAINT_FUEL1.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_FUEL_SUB
MAINT_FUEL1.Description_Text: A piece of rechargeable power technology. The fuel inverter ensures an even flow of power to autonomous machines.

MAINT_FUEL2.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_FUEL2_NAME
MAINT_FUEL2.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_FUEL_SUB
MAINT_FUEL2.Description_Text: The membrane battery is an almost maintenance-free piece of rechargeable power technology. Nestled among in the machine's circuits, it supplies power safely and directly.

MAINT_FUEL3.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_FUEL3_NAME
MAINT_FUEL3.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_FUEL_SUB
MAINT_FUEL3.Description_Text: A piece of rechargeable power technology. The power condenser harvests any heat energy wasted during the machine's operation, and uses it to generate extra power.

MAINT_FUEL4.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_FUEL4_NAME
MAINT_FUEL4.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_FUEL_SUB
MAINT_FUEL4.Description_Text: The generator coupling is an important piece of the machine's rechargeable power systems. Without it, the generator would fruitlessly spin, pumping power out into the void.

MAINT_FUEL5.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_FUEL5_NAME
MAINT_FUEL5.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_FUEL_SUB
MAINT_FUEL5.Description_Text: The kinetic dynamo takes a small initial charge and uses it to run power-harvesting systems that tap into the orbit of the planet. This frees autonomous machinery from frequent fuel inspections, allowing them to endure extremely long maintenance cycles.

MAINT_TECH1.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH1_NAME
MAINT_TECH1.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH1.Description_Text: A simple locking device, designed to keep out unauthorised pilferers. Damage has locked it permanently.

MAINT_TECH2.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH2_NAME
MAINT_TECH2.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH2.Description_Text: An advanced locking device. A polarity incident has caused it to seal shut permanently.

MAINT_TECH3.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH3_NAME
MAINT_TECH3.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH3.Description_Text: A highly advanced locking device. Damage to the circuits supplying the magnet has caused it to lock permanently.

MAINT_TECH4.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH4_NAME
MAINT_TECH4.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH4.Description_Text: A terminal designed to allow manual control of the device. Damage prevents it actually receiving any input.

MAINT_TECH5.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH5_NAME
MAINT_TECH5.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH5.Description_Text: An advanced control unit, designed to allow device/flesh interaction. Damage prevents it functioning correctly. Interfacing while it is in this state is not advised.

MAINT_TECH6.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH6_NAME
MAINT_TECH6.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH6.Description_Text: A small boiler, generating heat to allow the device to function in difficult climates. A malfunction has resulted in a damaging boiler overflow.

MAINT_TECH7.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH7_NAME
MAINT_TECH7.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH7.Description_Text: A very small motor, designed to power very small parts. It has corroded, and is full of very small rust.

MAINT_TECH8.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH8_NAME
MAINT_TECH8.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH8.Description_Text: A pump and heat exchange system designed to keep the device from overheating. It has itself overheated, and is no longer functional.

MAINT_TECH9.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH9_NAME
MAINT_TECH9.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH9.Description_Text: A display terminal designed to communicate the device's status to the user. As the terminal is broken, the user cannot be made aware that the terminal is broken.

MAINT_TECH10.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH10_NAME
MAINT_TECH10.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH10.Description_Text: A unit designed to destroy vital systems in the event that the device is tampered with by an unauthorised party. Unfortunately, it has itself malfunctioned and will continue to damage other systems until repaired.

MAINT_TECH11.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH11_NAME
MAINT_TECH11.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH11.Description_Text: A small light/klaxon hybrid, designed to warn of unauthorised access to the device. Damage to the alarm has caused it to overload and short other nearby circuits.

MAINT_TECH12.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH12_NAME
MAINT_TECH12.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH12.Description_Text: The casing for a high-compression spring. The casing has ruptured, causing the spring to shoot out and damage the rest of the device.

MAINT_TECH13.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH13_NAME
MAINT_TECH13.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH13.Description_Text: A control unit designed to keep temperatures even across the device. The sensor unit is damaged, causing it to vent or generate heat at inappropriate times.

MAINT_TECH14.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH14_NAME
MAINT_TECH14.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH14.Description_Text: A high-capacity pump, ensuring that fuel reaches every part of the device in all gravitational conditions. The filter is clogged with a strange substance, causing it to lose power.

MAINT_TECH15.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH15_NAME
MAINT_TECH15.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH15.Description_Text: A small mechanical joint, used to correct small mechanical errors across the device. A malfunction is causing it to take functional components and push them into the wrong place, creating even more damage.

MAINT_TECH16.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH16_NAME
MAINT_TECH16.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH16.Description_Text: A relay switch, intended to aid the powering up of the device. The connectors have become corroded, and the solenoid is no longer functioning.

MAINT_TECH17.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH17_NAME
MAINT_TECH17.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH17.Description_Text: A small pressurised chamber, designed to create the compressed gas necessary for the device to function. Cracks have appeared in the chamber, causing it to leak.

MAINT_TECH18.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH18_NAME
MAINT_TECH18.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH18.Description_Text: The control circuit for all the other components in the device. Damage to this circuitry is fatal.

MAINT_TECH19.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH19_NAME
MAINT_TECH19.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH19.Description_Text: The central power unit for the device. Damage to the unit means it is currently distributing all the power to one particular circuit, causing a dangerous short.

MAINT_TECH20.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH20_NAME
MAINT_TECH20.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH20.Description_Text: A small unit designed to regulate the flow of power across the device. A malfunction is causing it to short, damaging other components.

MAINT_TECH21.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH21_NAME
MAINT_TECH21.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH21.Description_Text: A universal network interface, allowing the device to connect to a remote control centre. Damage to this interface is causing it to interpret background radiation as network signals, corrupting data in other circuits.

MAINT_TECH22.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH22_NAME
MAINT_TECH22.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH22.Description_Text: The safety panel seals off potentially dangerous components in the event of a malfunction. An over sensitive trigger has caused it to activate, preventing the device from operating.

MAINT_TECH23.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH23_NAME
MAINT_TECH23.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH23.Description_Text: The alternator generates and regulates power for the device. A strange corrosion seeps through it, preventing it from working.

MAINT_TECH24.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH24_NAME
MAINT_TECH24.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH24.Description_Text: A small but efficient panel, designed to harvest light and convert it to power. However, the panel is now cracked and dusty, and can no longer be relied on.

MAINT_TECH25.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH25_NAME
MAINT_TECH25.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB
MAINT_TECH25.Description_Text: The gearing mechanism for the device. The lubricant that keeps it operational appears to have been replaced with an otherworldly green goo, and the gears are now stuck.

MAINT_PORTAL1.Subtitle: UI_PORTAL_GLYPH_SUB

MAINT_S13.Description_Text:
A groove cut into the smooth grey stone of the <SPECIAL>Portal<>.

A light within pulses gently, expectant.

MAINT_HOOVER.Name: UI_HOOVER_TECH_NAME
MAINT_HOOVER.Subtitle: UI_HOOVER_TECH_SUB
MAINT_HOOVER.Description_Text:
Gathers resources directly from the interstellar medium, via a complex system of suction intakes and condensing tubes. The gathered substance <TECHNOLOGY>varies<> with the local <TECHNOLOGY>star classification<>.

Powered directly from the freighter's main electrical loop. Functionality is entirely <STELLAR>autonomous<>.

MAINT_BAIT.Subtitle: UI_BAIT_BOX_SUB
MAINT_BAIT.Description_Text:
Insert <STELLAR>bait or lures<> to attract <TECHNOLOGY>specific fish<>, or to improve <TECHNOLOGY>catch chances<>. Note: any foodstuff may be used as bait.

MAINT_FRIG8.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH19_NAME
MAINT_FRIG8.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB

MAINT_FRIG9.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH24_NAME
MAINT_FRIG9.Subtitle: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH_SUB

MAINT_FRIG10.Name: UI_MAINTAIN_TECH25_NAME
